description: Transliterate text to Latin ASCII, or make a URL slug from it. Covers Cyrillic, Greek, Turkish, German, Nordic, Polish, Vietnamese and accented Latin letters. Characters with no table entry (Arabic, Hebrew, CJK ...) are kept and listed in unconverted, not guessed. Up to 2,000 characters. Pure code. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

mode.description: ascii (default) or slug (lowercase words joined by the separator)

name: text_transliterate
title: Text Transliterate
